# OpenPlaid

OpenPlaid is an MIT-licensed library of experimental bank payment adapters.
Read the exact capability and limitations; parser output is not bank authenticity or settlement.

Repository: https://github.com/0xSachinK/openplaid
Instructions: https://github.com/0xSachinK/openplaid/blob/main/AGENTS.md
Contribution skill: https://github.com/0xSachinK/openplaid/blob/main/skills/contribute-bank/SKILL.md
Review skill: https://github.com/0xSachinK/openplaid/blob/main/skills/review-contribution/SKILL.md
Verifier operations: https://github.com/0xSachinK/openplaid/blob/main/skills/operate-verifier/SKILL.md
Verification guide: https://github.com/0xSachinK/openplaid/blob/main/docs/verification.md
Machine discovery: /.well-known/openplaid.json
Integration catalog: /catalog.json

Never upload raw banking records, HARs or session credentials to GitHub or the website.
The verifier is in development; no live secret-sharing endpoint is enabled.
No scheduled agent tasks or automatic payouts are enabled. Published issue terms govern awards.
